summary: Executed full requested regression on preview URL. Backend contracts passed 8/8 with expected AR totals (12570, 12 customers, 15 vehicles) and read-only safeguards. Frontend DebtFollowUp no longer hangs on loading, but still renders zero/empty despite APIs returning positive AR balances.

ui_bugs.issue: Page exits loading but shows empty state and customer AR card 0.00 / count 0 instead of expected 12570 / 12.

integration_issues.issue: In-browser API probes returned 200 for /api/customers and /api/suppliers; recomputation from same payload gives 12 positive customers and total 12570, but UI state remains empty.

action_items: Fix DebtFollowUp data hydration path so successful customers/suppliers responses populate entries and metrics.
Review fetchData timeout/fallback behavior to prevent false-empty rendering when APIs are slow but successful.
Add lightweight runtime logging or guarded parsing around merged mapping/filter stage in DebtFollowUp for visibility of silent empty-state failures.
critical_code_review_comments: VehicleDetails resolveItemBillingType now preserves part as workshop; supplier is applied only when itemType/billingType is supplier.
VehicleFinancialSummary supplier label is updated to 'حركة الموردين' with archival context subtitle.
Backend AR contracts remain aligned with policy: workshop items only, supplier items excluded, confirmed journal payments only, and no auto journal creation during read flows.

success_rate.frontend: 50% (route/login load pass; debts follow-up data render failed)

seed_data_creation: No seed data created. No DB mutation/restore/migration actions executed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend expected values validated on preview: /api/finance/ar/customers total_ar=12570 vehicles=15 customers=12; /api/customers positive balances sum=12570 with 12 positive customers; /api/finance/ar/ledger ending_balance=12570 rows=12; income sales_summary operations_total=12570, operations_credit_total=12570, cash/pos/bank_transfer=0. Frontend DebtFollowUp now exits loading but still shows zero/empty despite APIs returning valid data.
rca of the issue: Reproduced via Playwright after login (مدير/123123): /debts-followup renders empty with customer card 0.00/count 0. Network probe shows 200 responses for /api/customers and /api/suppliers, and in-page recomputation from fetched payload yields 12 positive customers totaling 12570. This indicates a frontend hydration/state integration bug (likely timeout fallback or silent processing path) rather than backend data correctness.
